market_scope: Publisher indexed listed services and monitored facilitator flows, not whole x402 ecosystem

conditional_tail_fee_math.formula: reported listed-service flow * (1 - rounded top10 share) * hypothetical fee rate * hypothetical capture fraction
conditional_tail_fee_math.interpretation: Scenario arithmetic only; neither attainable platform revenue nor total market ceiling. Assumes fee is chargeable on routed volume, ignores all costs.

comparison_with_prior_publisher_snapshot.caveat: Overlapping rolling windows and revised publisher estimates; differences are not sales growth.

caveats: Buyer addresses are not unique paying people or firms.
Publisher monitoring and deduplication claims have not been independently audited.
Top-one imported service and 98.8% largest-buyer-address concentration make organic demand inference fragile.
Top-ten share is rounded; derived fee-pool amounts are approximate.
Coverage is of publisher's measured facilitator flow, not entire x402 ecosystem.
Catalog listings and observed settlements do not prove AgentMine demand, payment conversion, customers or revenue.
